name: LOW-VIX band trend continuation — positive-funding carry-confirmed ride
rationale: Thesis: a healthy uptrend in a calm regime is one longs are willing to PAY to hold — mildly positive perp funding (funding_rate gt funding_floor) inside a calm-VIX band (vix_level between, above dead-quiet and below stress) confirms genuine long demand, not a thin grind. Require positive momentum (ret_Nd gt mom_floor) for direction. The BETWEEN band avoids both the dead-quiet tape with no follow-through and the stress regime where trends break. Exit when funding overheats above funding_ceiling (froth) OR momentum fails OR risk/time stops. Disconfirmer 1 (is the funding gate load-bearing?): the identical low-VIX + momentum long with NO funding gate is in the cohort — if it matches the deflated Sharpe, carry confirmation adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2 (froth check): if entries cluster only at high funding and the holdout is negative, this is buying froth, not continuation. Disconfirmer 3 (holdout): purged+embargoed recent slice must hold.
catalyst: VIX inside calm band AND positive funding AND positive momentum
